[P2] Resolve the untested environment-validation branch

CONTRIBUTING.md rule 4 requires a behavioral test for every new branch. The package tests only inspect handler source text, and the deployed template supplies the environment variable, so neither verifies this initialization-failure path. Its error behavior can regress without any assertion failing. Return to the design phase under rule 9: decide whether missing-configuration handling belongs in this fixture, then either remove the unnecessary branch or retain it with a test that requires its behavior.
